reviewerFeedback:
another layout was rated poor: 风险说明被压成约5字/行的窄条，行高被拉得很长；项目、负责人、进度也频繁断行。预算列虽勉强保住金额完整，整体仍难横向比较。 | another layout was rated poor: 预算列比A更窄，表头“预算（万元）”和金额被挤压；风险列仍只有约5—6字/行，项目名与进度竖排感强，阅读节奏碎。 | another layout was rated bad: 把更多宽度给了风险列，但项目/负责人只剩约2字/行，表头竖排，整表异常高；预算列也不足以稳放金额，拆东墙补西墙，最难扫读。 | another layout was rated acceptable: 唯一明显把长文本风险列作为主列，风险说明约9字/行，行高明显下降；但矫正过度，项目列窄到近乎逐字竖排，负责人、进度、预算也被压扁，表头和金额缺少呼吸。 | your previous preferred design was rated poor: 风险列约5字/行，项目与进度大量断行；列宽分配接近A/B但预算更窄，金额和表头受挤压，整体仍像几条竖条并排。 | another layout was rated poor: 风险列略宽于A/E，但仍只有约5字/行；各列平均偏窄，项目名、进度和预算都碎，缺少主次。
another layout was rated poor: 风险说明 is squeezed into a very narrow strip, making the table extremely tall; project and progress cells also fragment into short stacks that are hard to scan. | another layout was rated good: Best overall balance: project names and budget values remain comparatively readable, while the risk column gets enough width for continuous prose; some wrapping remains but row rhythm holds. | another layout was rated acceptable: Risk prose gets more room, but project, owner and budget columns are over-compressed, with names and numbers breaking awkwardly; a less balanced tradeoff. | your previous preferred design was rated acceptable: Project, owner and budget are reasonably legible, but the risk column is too narrow for its long text, creating tall dense rows. | another layout was rated acceptable: Similar to D but with an even tighter risk column; several short fields wrap awkwardly, making comparison harder. | another layout was rated poor: Risk gets the most space and the table is shortest, but project and owner columns collapse to one character per line, destroying the row identifiers.
